what: the answer key of the public accuracy sets, by version (D-1104): built at run time by tools/public_accuracy from the pinned sources, never committed; this file pins what is known of each version

v1.what: as launch P1b used it (builder of master fa639b61): birth date 1 July of the visit's year minus the age; placed age lines in years, written even when the protocol states the bound; JMED truth from the structured 主病名/既往歴/現病歴
v1.build: python -m tools.public_accuracy build --set SET --out DIR --for-box --ref DAY --key v1

launch_p1b.what: sha256 of each file of built/gold as the run stored it (written.json and key.json did not exist then)

v2.what: B1-B3 of the P1b review: B1 birth date the visit minus the stated age in its unit; B2 placed age lines keep their unit and a bound the protocol states is not written again; B3 JMED truth from the note the box reads, over the same patients as v1; D-1064: an eligible pair whose own criterion labels exclude the patient is marked conflicted, not relabelled
v2.build: python -m tools.public_accuracy build --set SET --out DIR --for-box --ref DAY (--key v2 is the default)
v2.why_no_sha256: not built here: the sources (the SIGIR files, ClinicalTrials.gov's fields, the JMED-Personas parquet) are fetched at build time and are not in the repository; H-2 made no network call. The first v2 build adds its sha256 here as a new entry
